text:
elaine: Heads-up1Q recurrence check. I ran a rollup across PMFs and postmortems to find recurring operational signals tied to recent regressions. High-level: three buckets dominate (1) cold KV storms during multi-model swaps, (2) autoscaler bounce when burst traffic overlaps with warmup, (3) short-lived cross-AZ retransmits causing RPC retries. Adding owners and a proposed phased plan below.

raj: Nice. What windows and counts did you use?

elaine: Window = 2025-11-01 .. 2026-03-15. Aggregate counts: kv-storms=18, autoscale-bounce=11, az-retransmit=9. Query I used (approx):```sql
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT incident_id, root_cause, timestamp
  FROM incidents
  WHERE created_at >= '2025-11-01' AND created_at <= '2026-03-15'
)
SELECT root_cause, count(*) cnt
FROM filtered
GROUP BY root_cause
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```

maria: kv-storms - is that mostly Dedicated or Private? any particular customers?

elaine: 60% Dedicated, 30% Private VPC, 10% Hosted. Spread across customers but concentrated on large-context models and sessions that do rapid model rotation in the same session.

ops-bot: ops-bot created ticket INF-4982 for "KV storm mitigation + per-model cold counters"

raj: Proposed ownership: raj -> autoscaler stabilization (RFC + 2 canaries), maria -> KV counter + adaptive warmup, cj -> cross-AZ retry smoothing + circuit breaker. Agree?

cj: I can take cross-AZ. My plan: add jittered retry backoff + per-route circuit breaker; roll canary to 5% regions then 25%. Target: initial canary in 8 business days.

maria: I'll add per-model cold-start counters (metric id: metrics.kv.cold_starts.v1) and an ephemeral warmup path for model-swap flows. Target: PoC in 10 days, mitigation in 3 weeks.

raj: For autoscaler I want to try hysteresis + short-term smoothing window (30s) and a max scale-down ramp (no more than 20% per min). I'll draft RFC. Target: RFC + perf runs in 7 days.

elaine: I'll own the consolidated runbook updates and customer-impact classification. Also adding a new postmortem tag "recurrence:kv-swap" for easier future rollups.

ops-bot: ops-bot linked INF-4982, INF-4983, INF-4984 to epic INF-4990 "Recurring patterns sprint 2026-Q1"

elaine: Quick ask: can we add a lightweight smoke test for model swaps that runs in CI nightly? If it fails, block deployment to Dedicated.

maria: Yes - we can add a smoke job that does a short swap with synthetic prefixes and asserts kv.hit_ratio > 0.6 within 30s.

cj: Also recommend we track two SLO-adjacent metrics: tail-95 latency for swap flows and retry-rate-per-route. Those will help us know when canary thresholds are crossed.

raj: Action item list (owners + targets):
- INF-4982 maria: KV counters + warmup PoC (10d) + mitigation (3w)
- INF-4983 raj: Autoscaler hysteresis RFC + perf canary (7d)
- INF-4984 cj: Cross-AZ retry smoothing + canary (8bd)
- INF-4990 elaine: Runbook updates + postmortem tags + customer impact comms (2w)

elaine: I'll schedule a checkpoint in two weeks here and add a short one-pager to the incident wiki. Please update tickets with PR links and test links.

maria: small technical note: for per-model counters, we should shard by model_version + deployment_id to avoid cardinality blowup. I'll annotate that in INF-4982.

ops-bot: reminder-bot scheduled follow-up in #incidents in 14 days for thread 2123456789

raj: If anyone needs perf harness access ping me. Also we should consider a retrospective in the monthly ops review to validate whether the mitigations reduce recurrence rate by >= 50% over 30 days.

elaine: Agreed. Thanks all. If there are blockers post the ticket numbers. Closing here until the checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
